notes.title: Chinese Localization Preview
notes.content:
🌙 Everholm - Chinese Localization Preview & Major Update Sneak Peek!

Hi everyone!

We’re excited to share that a preview of our Chinese localization is now live on the beta branch of Everholm! While we continue polishing this translation, we also want to give you a sneak peek into what’s coming in our major upcoming update.

To access the beta version, go into the Everholm Steam properties -> Betas -> select: Public - beta For Public -> run the game!


[b]🛠️ What We’re Working On:[/b]

[b]🌑 A Deeper, More Meaningful Story[/b]
[list]
[*] Story progression will no longer be hidden behind NPC heart levels.
[*] Dreams and key story moments will be tied to Underworld biomes and boss fights.
[*] Expect foreshadowing, twists, and a satisfying conclusion at the end of the storyline.
[/list]

[b]🧍‍♀️ NPC Rework & Dialogues[/b]
[list]
[*] NPCs are getting full portraits with emotions and reactions.
[*] Dialogues will move to classic bottom-screen boxes with player choice options.
[*] Heart levels will unlock new recipes, blueprints, and gifts.
[*] Updated designs for a more cohesive and age-balanced cast.
[/list]

[b]📖 Lore & Exploration[/b]
[list]
[*] Discover Everholm’s past through collectible Archive Pages.
[*] New quests and events will unveil deeper NPC backstories and world lore.
[/list]

[b]🧭 Quest System Overhaul[/b]
[list]
[*] Smarter, more relevant quests based on your progress.
[*] Two types: item-based and action quests (like finding lost animals or clearing monsters).
[*] Better pacing and more rewarding questlines.
[/list]

[b]🍀 Luck System Rebalance[/b]
[list]
[*] New mechanics and activities for bad luck days.
[*] No more streaks of endless bad luck — we’re capping them!
[*] Always something fun to do, every day.
[/list]

[b]📚 Archive [/b]
[list]
[*] Archive: donate rare items and pages for rewards and lore.
[*] Translate lost scriptures
[*] Discover secrets and mysteries!
[/list]

[b]🧑‍🍳 Cooking Expansion[/b]
[list]
[*] More recipes, ingredient synergy, on-the-go cooking, and deeper gifting/crafting integration.
[/list]

[b]🌟 Achievements, Ports & More[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam achievements incoming!
[*] Full localization begins with Chinese and expands from there.
[*] Consoles (Switch, Xbox, PS) are in our sights post-update.
[/list]



We’re incredibly grateful for your support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for being part of Everholm’s journey! 🌾💜

[i]— The Everholm Team[/i]

notes.title: Everholm Major Update 1.1.0 is here!!
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Hey everyone! ✨   [/h2]

We are very excited for this update and for more to come! 🎉  
We listened to your feedback and decided to separate the most wanted features and suggestions into a few [b]Major Updates[/b]!

[h2]🛠️ 1.1.0 Changes & New Content!  [/h2]


 [h3]📜 [b]Quests Overhauled![/b] [/h3]– Quests are now way more achievable and rewarding! No more impossible fetch quests!  We made a whole system to track your in-game progress and based on that some Everfolk will give out quests that make sense for your current abilities! 

[h3]🍀 [b]Luck Adjusted![/b] [/h3]– No more bad luck streaks! The system has been improved to prevent repeated unlucky days. This way the game should feel much more relaxed! We are also thinking of ways to add mini games that would be better played on bad luck days so you guys would have something fun to do on bad luck days!

[h3]🍳 [b]Cooking is here![/b] [/h3]– The kitchen is no longer just for show! You can now cook delicious recipes to aid you in your adventures! We’ve added [b]50 recipes[/b] for you to discover, with more on the way! 

[h3]📖 [b]Compendium Added![/b] [/h3]– Track your discoveries, learn about sell & buy values of each item, track how you got it, and more! Great for completionists!  


🐛 [h3]Bug Fixes![/h3] – Issues resolved and adjusted:

[list]
  [*] ❄️ Fixed ghost-feeding freeze  
  [*] ⚔️ Zoe dialogue - freeze
  [*] 🐔 Animals get out of their housing properly!
  [*] 🐝 Calendar can be opened by clicking on the date!
  [*] 💩 White poop now actually speeds up plant growth by 40%!
  [/list]

[h3] Why Check It Out?  [/h3]

This update makes Everholm’s gameplay feel so much more rewarding[/b]! 🌿✨  
If you’ve played before, [b]now’s the time to dive back in[/b] and see the improvements!  

[h3] Future plans![/h3]
[b]Another Major Update is on the way![/b]! ✨  

[*] New fun quests!
[*] The Archive...
[*] Localization system (Chinese first, more to come!)
[*] Story improvements
[*] Npc dialogues with big portraits and emotions
[*] Achievements
[*] Cutscenes


[h3]💬 Let Us Know What You Think!   [/h3]

Your feedback is [b]invaluable[/b] to us! 💖  
We are always available to you on Discord or here in the Steam Discussions for any issues, suggestions or questions! 🏡  

We hope you love the update and enjoy the game! 🌿✨  

[i][b]Chonky Loaf Team 💜[/b][/i]

✨ 1.0.12 ✨

[h3]🪲 Bugs 🪲[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a collision bug in the upgraded house kitchen.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mana, Energy, and Health would not reset to their max value when loading.
[*] Fixed the Watering Can not saving its water level and resetting when stored in a chest.

[*] Seeding plants now works with Aim-Assist on controllers

Have a great day! 💜

notes.title: 1.0.11 - Controllers Auto Aim and No Energy charge for missing a tile!
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Everholm Update 1.0.11 🎉[/h2]

[h3]🌟 New Features[/h3]
We’ve heard your requests loud and clear! These two highly anticipated features are finally here, and we’re so excited to share them with you:

[*] [b]No more penalties for unsuccessful tool use!🌱[/b]
[list]  
[*] Missing a swing or digging in the wrong spot? No problem! Players won’t lose energy for failed actions.  
[*] Tools like the Pickaxe, Axe, Scythe, Fishing Rod, and Hoe now only consume energy for successful actions.  
[b]Note: [/b]The Watering Can will receive the same fix in the next update—stay tuned!  
[/list]  
[*] [b]Added auto-aim for controllers! 🎮  [/b]
[list]  
[*]Interactions have never been smoother! This new feature ensures your tools will automatically target the correct object, regardless of the direction you’re facing.  
[*] For example, you can now chop down a tree even if your character is looking slightly away from it. Effortless and precise!  
[*] You now have a handy indicator showing you what you can interact with based on the tool you have selected in your inventory while using a controller!

[h3] Make sure to toggle Auto-Aim ON in your settings menu if it's not on by default [/h3]

[/list]  
[h3]🔧 Improvements and Changes[/h3]
[*] Added notifications and sound effects for unlocking the greenhouse.  
[*] Improved greenhouse layout for perfect symmetry.  
[*] Updated descriptions for the Pickle Jam Machine, Mayo Machine, Keg, and Strawberry Wine.  
[*] Main Menu now clearly indicates save file deletions with a bold red "DELETE SAVE FILE:" prompt.  

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*] Fixed rain sound being audible in the underworld.  
[*] Machines with 0 fuel on load now properly set the output item after refueling.  
[*] Resolved an occasional issue where clicking on an item in the backpack wouldn’t work.  
[*] Optimized plant behavior and animations for smoother gameplay.  
[*] Fixed time freezing indefinitely after a boss fight.  
[*] Limited ghost spawns to a maximum of 5 at a time.  
[*] Fixed insects spawning at day end instead of day start.  
[*] Mima’s Moon Honey quest now correctly asks for Moon Honey instead of Hardwood.  
[*] Fixed Lilly’s night light from obscuring paths in the underworld biome (floor spiral teleport).  

Stay tuned for more QOL updates coming your way!  
Thank you, everyone!

With love,  
[i]Chonky Loaf Team[/i]

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
[h2] Here's what we've been working on: [/h2]

[h5] Steam Cloud Save! ☁️ [/h5]
[list]
This was requested by many people and it's our job to listen! 
Steam cloud save is fully integrated and tested, works on Steam Deck too! 
[/list]
[h5]Windowed mode that works well! 🪟[/h5]
[list]
Requested by streamers, people with Ultra Wide monitors and other window mode lovers!
[/list]
[h5] Zoom in and out! 🔎 [/h5]  
[list]
There's only a few levels currently, but it will be useful until we figure out how to do some finer zoom adjustments.
[/list]
[h5]Text in Cutscenes does not auto scroll anymore! ⏳ [/h5]  
[list]
Once the typewriter effect is done, your input is required to continue the cutscene, this way all of the text will be easily readable and you won't miss a thing!
[/list]
[h5]Fishing minigame toggle! 🎣 [/h5]  
[list]
Simply open up your settings and turn off the Fishing minigame! Simple as that!
You will still have to upgrade your fishing rod to get all of the fish though!
[/list]
[h5]Dropped items are saved! 💾 [/h5]  
[list]
Anything dropped on the surface of Everholm will be saved. ( wild animal loot, rewards, anything really )
[/list]
[h3]Changes ✏️[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fiona house is not so dark anymore
[*] Night time in Fall is brighter
[*] No Npc friendship decay
[*] Npc tracking by default with 0 hearts needed
[*] Rain doesn't affect the interiors
[*] Rain doesn't fall on festivals
[*] Rain falls less in spring and summer
[*] Disliked gifts have less of an impact
[*] Loved gifts bring more points
[*] Added Pond and Lake on the map
[*] Added Light in the Home interior fireplace
[*] Animals are way less needy
[*] Each Animal eats only 1 food from the feeder
[*] Bee house reworked and balanced
[*] Cauldron Festival gives very valuable rewards depending on the amount of stars you get
[*] Added a better description of how the Cauldron mini-game works
[*] Barn and Coop are much smaller in size and take a lot less tiles
[*] Fruit trees are sold at Marry's shop in winter
[*] Added text to Trinket descriptions : “Place it in your backpack [ring/necklace/etc] slot”
[*] Adjusted Field Frenzy, Rain Cloud, Swift sprout to be cheaper but also take more energy and mana
[*] Shadow tools require a Star Gem now
[*] Maple and Paul interior changed camera to follow player to a degree
[*] Easter Race rewards can now be sold
[*] Flowers are harvested only with scythe ( easier honey harvesting )
[*] Mayo , Cheese machines fuel changes and ratio
[*] Vine Rope drop buffed
[*] Marry's shop items now go up to 999 items per day
[*] Added [Multi harvest] and [Harvestable with scythe] in descriptions of seeds (with a different color)
[*] Spinach seeds adjusted
[/list]
[h3]Bugs 🐞[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collision traps (for all collisions)
[*] Ghosts caused a crash when talking to them
[*] Boss fight caused a crash
[*] Animals reset when max hearts bug fixed
[*] Having exactly 9 health when using fishing rod would freeze the game
[*] Machines could change their already smelted (refined) product in certain situations
[*] Not getting items when inventory full ( these items will drop on the map and be saved waiting for you now )
[*] Ghosts caused a freeze in other UIs
[*] Some players couldn't use the Greenhouse key
[*] Optimized bees
[*] Underworld trees are now affected by Axe strength
[*] Bounds collision was missing in one of the dreams
[/list]
